static.portsAndDocks: preserve 27 canonical docking coordinates and harbor interactions; coast can expose separate landing candidates after collision review
static.openWater: free choice of heading anywhere in connected physically navigable water; no mandatory ferry corridor, teleport edge, rail path or predetermined A→B voyage
static.currentAuthoredFerries: 8 inherited ferries are optional navigational suggestions/story routes, NOT physical permissions and NOT the only water connections
static.boatCollision: open-water candidate only; depth, draft, obstacles, current and mode to be signed off before actual movement
static.footOnSea: FORBIDDEN; cargoPassable on sea likewise false
static.moveGraph: cells adjacent over actual water, with continuous spatial movement and no ferry-only route constraints; later renderer uses continuous world positions not 8AU snaps
static.shoreline: solid coast except validated docks/landings; cannot dock automatically just because a water cell neighbors dry land
static.pathChoice: any sea water start and destination; returns an optional geometric route and hazards, never moves the player automatically

gameSystems.vehicle: Gameplay selects boat/raft/swim/ship capabilities, steering/throttle/stamina/fuel, weather impact and physical clearance
gameSystems.heatedSea: localized water/air exposure, steam, thermal clues, overheating risk and cooling opportunity; no invented damage or temperature constants
gameSystems.deathSea: roaming unique aquatic threat with telegraphed detection/wake cues, evasion/stealth/alternate route; no automatic proximity raid while offline
gameSystems.routePlanning: optional map hints, no hard path; hazard info changes navigational decisions, not locked scripted ferry
gameSystems.save: persistent vessel world position, item custody, unique monster identity, encounter state and environmental mutation across offline/online
gameSystems.weather: wind/waves/storm/fog/current interactions; ocean may be risky but navigable with equipment and decisions

owner.MAP: static sea polygon, dock and island geometry, exposure domain
owner.GAMEPLAY: movement, vehicle, monster, weather, hazard rules
owner.CREATOR: art/visual approval
